title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – 等级 B

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q1: Candle Burned First
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第1题：最先熄灭的蜡烛

content.en: Akira lights 5 identical candles all at the same time. They stopped burning at different times and now look as shown. Which candle stopped burning first?
content.zh: 小安将 5 支相同的蜡烛同时点燃。蜡烛在不同时间停止燃烧，现在如图。哪支蜡烛最先停止燃烧？

explanation.en: Identical candles: first out is the one that decreased least (shortest leftover).
explanation.zh: 相同蜡烛：最先熄灭的是烧得最少、剩余最短的那支。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q2: Kangaroo Coin Value
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第2题：袋鼠硬币面值

content.en: The 2 kangaroo coins with the question mark have the same value. What is this value? 20+10+10+?+?+1=51
content.zh: 标注问号的两枚袋鼠硬币面值相同。面值是多少？20+10+10+?+?+1=51

explanation.en: 51−20−10−10−1=10 for two equal coins ⇒ each 5.
explanation.zh: 两枚问号共 10，每枚 5。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q3: Clock Face Holes
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第3题：钟面圆盘孔

content.en: A gray circle with 2 large holes is put on a clock-face and turned around its center. Which 2 numbers is it possible to see at the same time?
content.zh: 带两个孔的灰色圆盘放在钟面上并绕中心旋转。哪两个数字可能同时被看到？

explanation.en: The holes are 4 hours apart; only 5 and 9 fit.
explanation.zh: 两孔相差 4 小时；只有 5 和 9 符合。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q4: Puzzle Square Pieces
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第4题：拼成正方形

content.en: Alice has puzzle pieces 1–4. Which 2 pieces can she put together to form the square shown?
content.zh: 小艾有拼图 1–4。她可以用哪两块拼成图中的正方形？

explanation.en: Pieces 1 and 4 fit the square.
explanation.zh: 拼图 1 与 4 能拼成正方形。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q5: Exactly Two Lights On
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第5题：恰好两灯同亮

content.en: A light engineer turns lights on and off using the plan shown. How long in total are exactly 2 of the lights on at the same time?
content.zh: 灯光开关计划如图。恰好有 2 盏灯同时亮起的总时长是多少？

explanation.en: Exactly two lights are on for 8 of the minutes shown.
explanation.zh: 恰好两灯同亮共 8 分钟。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q6: Fold Transparent Paper
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第6题：折叠透明纸

content.en: Kristoffer folds the transparent paper along the dashed line. What can he then see?
content.zh: 小凯沿虚线折叠透明纸。他能看到什么图案？

explanation.en: Fold along the dashed line and match overlays.
explanation.zh: 沿虚线对折后对照图案。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q7: Three-Disc Towers
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第7题：三层圆盘塔

content.en: Anna has 4 discs of different sizes. She builds a tower of 3 discs so every disc is smaller than the one below it. How many different towers can she make?
content.zh: 小娜有 4 张大小不同的圆盘，建 3 层塔且每层都比下面小。能建多少种不同的塔？

explanation.en: Choose any 3 of 4 sizes; only one stacking order each ⇒ C(4,3)=4.
explanation.zh: 从 4 盘中选 3 盘，大小顺序唯一 ⇒ 4 种。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q8: Glue on Black Circle
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第8题：粘在黑圆上

content.en: Danny glued 2 pieces of paper on top of the black circle. What can he not obtain?
content.zh: 小丹把两张纸粘在黑色圆上。他无法获得以下哪个图案？

explanation.en: All options except E can be obtained by stacking the two pieces.
explanation.zh: 除 E 外均可由两片叠出。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q9: Piece Covering the Dot
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第9题：盖住圆点的碎片

content.en: The shape on the right is covered with the 5 pieces below. Which piece will cover the dot?
content.zh: 右侧图形被下方 5 个碎片覆盖。哪个碎片会盖住圆点？

explanation.en: Tiling forces piece A over the dot.
explanation.zh: 铺满后圆点被 A 覆盖。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q10: Balanced Scale Weight
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第10题：天平旁的砝码

content.en: There are weights 1–6 kg. Rossitza puts five on the scales and one aside; the scales balance. Which weight did she put aside?
content.zh: 砝码 1–6 千克。小罗放五个在天平上，剩一个旁置，天平平衡。旁置的是多重？

explanation.en: Aside weight 1 kg matches the pictured balanced scale.
explanation.zh: 旁置 1 kg 与图中天平一致。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q11: Faded Ruler Marks
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第11题：褪色刻度尺

content.en: Ali’s 60 cm ruler has faded marks, but he can measure 10,20,30,40,50,60 cm using it only once. Which is Ali’s ruler?
content.zh: 60 cm 尺部分刻度褪色，但一次测量可得 10–60 cm（每 10）。哪把是他的尺子？

explanation.en: Marks at 10 and 40 allow all required lengths once.
explanation.zh: 刻度 10、40 可一次量出全部所需长度。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 Q12: Houses West of Road B
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -1 第12题：路B西面的房屋

content.en: 7 houses north of Road A, 8 east of Road B, 5 south of Road A. How many houses are west of Road B?
content.zh: 路 A 北 7 栋、路 B 东 8 栋、路 A 南 5 栋。路 B 西面有多少栋？

explanation.en: All houses = 7+5=12; west of B = 12−8=4.

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q13: Cars with Two People
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第13题：只坐两人的车

content.en: 8 cars wait for the ferry; each has 2 or 3 people; 19 people total. How many cars contain exactly 2 people?
content.zh: 8 辆车排队，每辆 2 或 3 人，共 19 人。恰好坐 2 人的车有几辆？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q14: Metro 96th Stop
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第14题：地铁第96站

content.en: Metro stations A–F; train reverses at ends. Started at B, first stop C. Which is the 96th stop?
content.zh: 地铁站 A–F，到终点折返。从 B 出发第一站 C。第 96 站是哪一站？

explanation.en: Period 10; 96 mod 10 = 6 → station D.

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q15: Colour Connected Circles
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第15题：圆圈最少着色

content.en: Hatice paints circles so any two connected by a line have different colours. Smallest number of colours needed?
content.zh: 相连圆圈不同色。最少需要多少种颜色？

explanation.en: Graph colouring needs 3 colours.
explanation.zh: 图着色最少 3 色。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q16: Maze Wall Stickers
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第16题：迷宫贴纸顺序

content.en: Sam walks the two-storey maze from entrance to exit, passing 3 wall stickers. In what order will she see them?
content.zh: 小莎走过两层迷宫，路过三张贴纸。她按什么顺序看到它们？

explanation.en: Path order: frog, then rhino, then shark.
explanation.zh: 路径顺序：青蛙→犀牛→鲨鱼。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q17: Kangaroos in a Line
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第17题：队列中的袋鼠

content.en: 6 beavers and 2 kangaroos in a line. Amongst any 3 consecutively numbered animals, exactly 1 is a kangaroo. Which numbered animal is a kangaroo?
content.zh: 6 海狸 2 袋鼠站成一排；任意连续 3 个中恰有 1 只袋鼠。哪个编号是袋鼠？

explanation.en: Only positions 3 and 6 work; so 3 is a kangaroo.
explanation.zh: 袋鼠只能在 3 与 6；故选 3。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q18: Fold Cut Unfold
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第18题：对折剪角展开

content.en: Rebecca folds a square twice, cuts off one corner, then unfolds. What does the paper look like?
content.zh: 正方形纸对折两次，剪掉一角再展开。展开后是什么样？

explanation.en: Two folds then cut corner unfolds to option B.
explanation.zh: 对折两次剪角展开对应 B。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q19: Entering Orders
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第19题：进入顺序

content.en: Hermione is never first, Harry never second, Ron never third. In how many different orders could they walk in?
content.zh: 赫敏不当第一，哈利不当第二，罗恩不当第三。有多少种进入顺序？

explanation.en: Only two orders: H→Hermione→Ron and H→Ron→Hermione.
explanation.zh: 仅两种：哈→赫→罗，哈→罗→赫。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q20: Correct Clock
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第20题：正确的钟

content.en: Five clocks: one hour fast, one hour slow, one correct, two stopped. Which shows the correct time?
content.zh: 五个钟：一个快一小时，一个慢一小时，一个正确，两个停走。哪个显示正确时间？

explanation.en: Correct time is 3 o’clock — clock D.
explanation.zh: 正确时间是 3 点，钟 D。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q21: Adam’s Blue Marbles
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第21题：小亚的蓝弹珠

content.en: Adam and Brenda have 9 marbles each; together 8 red and 10 blue. Brenda has twice as many blue as red. How many blue marbles does Adam have?
content.zh: 两人各 9 颗弹珠，共 8 红 10 蓝；小布蓝是红的两倍。小亚有几颗蓝弹珠？

explanation.en: Brenda 6 blue + 3 red; Adam has 4 blue.
explanation.zh: 小布 6 蓝 3 红；小亚蓝弹珠 4。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q22: Machines R and S
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第22题：机器R与S

content.en: Machine R rotates 90° clockwise; machine S stamps ♣. In which order are the machines used to produce the result shown?
content.zh: 机器 R 顺时针转 90°，机器 S 盖章 ♣。要得到图示结果，机器顺序是？

explanation.en: Two clockwise turns with stamp between ⇒ RSR.
explanation.zh: 盖章前后各转一次 ⇒ RSR。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q23: Circle Number Sums
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第23题：圆圈数字和

content.en: Write 1–7 in circles so neighbouring sums match the labels. What number must be in the green/shaded circle?
content.zh: 把 1–7 写入圆圈，相邻和如图。阴影圆圈必须写几？

explanation.en: Neighbour sums force 4 in the shaded circle.
explanation.zh: 相邻和推出阴影格为 4。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 Q24: Shaded Grid Guess
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2023 – Level B -2 第24题：阴影网格猜测

content.en: Maria shaded exactly 5 cells in a 4×4 grid. One friend is right; each of the others has four cells correct. Which is the correct grid?
content.zh: 4×4 中恰涂 5 格。一人全对，其余每人猜对 4 个阴影格。哪个是正确网格？

explanation.en: Only grid E is fully correct while others share exactly 4 shaded cells with it.
explanation.zh: 只有 E 全对，且与其余各恰重叠 4 个阴影格。
